q: The exponential family of distributions p(x;θ) = exp(θ·T(x) − A(θ) + B(x)) has the remarkable property that the Fisher information matrix equals:
opts: The Hessian of the log-partition function: G(θ) = ∇²A(θ)
exp: For exponential families, the Fisher information G(θ) = ∇²A(θ) = Cov_θ(T(X)). The log-partition function A(θ) is strictly convex (positive definite Fisher metric), and its Legendre transform gives the dual (m-flat) coordinate system η = E_θ[T(X)].
